check_skip_file: check whether a given file should be skipped or inlined by torch dynamo
check_verbose_function: check verbose skip/inline decision for a function object with detailed reason
add_skip_module: add a module to the skip list so dynamo skips functions in that module
check_torch_inline_allowed: check whether a torch module path is allowed to be inlined by dynamo
check_is_torch_file: check whether a file path belongs to the torch package excluding dynamo internals
